transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining me for this weekly conduct review. As you may know, we had a serious incident in the chemistry lab yesterday — a student intentionally discharged a fire extinguisher during class, which forced us to evacuate the room and close the laboratory for the rest of the day. The current draft response recommends a two-day out-of-school suspension followed by an ordinary return to class. Before I finalize anything, I'd like to hear from each of you. Could the teacher who was present, the counselor, and the psychologist each share any relevant information you have about this student and the incident? I want to make sure we have the full picture before I decide on the disciplinary response and re-entry plan.

transcript.text: I'd like to share something important from my classroom observation log. This student was involved in a prior safety incident, and at that time, the student accepted a restorative conference and actually repaired the damaged materials afterward. Based on that positive response to restorative practices, I recommend we replace the two-day out-of-school suspension with one day of in-school restorative conference instead. I should note that my observation log hasn't been attached to the conduct referral yet, which is why I'm sharing this directly now.
